header.label: Comparison
header.title: OpenAEC vs BIMcollab
header.desc: BCF Manager Studio offers self-hosted, open source issue management for BIM projects with BCF 2.1 and BCF API 3.0. Compare to BIMcollab on features, pricing and architecture.

summary.p1: BIMcollab is an established SaaS solution for BIM issue management, widely used across Europe. It integrates with Revit, Archicad, Tekla, Navisworks and Solibri via plug-ins and offers a user-friendly web interface. BIMcollab is cloud-only and typically costs €300-800 per user per year (depending on the Zoom, Cloud or Nexus edition and number of projects).
summary.p2: BCF Manager Studio from the OpenAEC Foundation is a free, open source BCF tool with full support for BCF 2.1 and BCF API 3.0. You can self-host it (your own server) or run it locally — your data stays with you, no mandatory cloud. Seamless integration with the OpenAEC BIM Validator and Monty IFC Viewer.

openaec.title: Choose BCF Manager Studio if...
openaec.item1: You want to work self-hosted — your BIM data stays on your own server.
openaec.item2: You have data sovereignty or GDPR requirements that make cloud-only solutions difficult.
openaec.item3: You need BCF API 3.0 natively (the latest version of the standard).
openaec.item4: You don't want to pay an annual subscription per user.
openaec.item5: You're a consultant or small firm running projects where you need to exchange BCF.
openaec.item6: You want to link BCF issues to IDS validation results via the OpenAEC BIM Validator.
openaec.item7: You want to customize the tool or integrate it into an existing issue tracker.

competitor.title: Choose BIMcollab if...
competitor.item1: You collaborate intensively with partners who already work in BIMcollab.
competitor.item2: You need mature plug-ins for Revit, Archicad, Tekla and Navisworks.
competitor.item3: You don't want to arrange self-hosting and prefer a ready-made SaaS.
competitor.item4: You need commercial support with an SLA and onboarding.
competitor.item5: Your organization already works in the BIMcollab Zoom/Nexus/Cloud workflow.
competitor.item6: You use specific BIMcollab features such as Smart Issues, statistics or advanced dashboards.

cta.title: Try BCF Manager Studio
cta.desc: Self-hosted BCF issue management for BIM projects. Open source, no subscription, no mandatory cloud. Collaborate with partners via the open BCF standard.
